claim: Singapore to the Philippines: a stablecoin was almost never the cheapest way to send.
calculation: From data/findings_hours_sgd_php_never_cheapest.csv (one row per priced hour at S$5,000): the share of hours in the last 28 days in which the stablecoin cost was below the cheapest app (stable_cheaper = true).
window: the last 28 days of priced hours
min_observations: at least 500 priced hours in the window
invalid_if: the finding's last recheck in data/findings.json is more than 6 hours old, or the minimum observations are not met
thresholds_text: holds: the stablecoin was cheapest in at most 1% of hours. weaker: up to 5%. no longer true: more than 5%.
proposed_by: Claude, 20 Oct 2026, from ROADMAP.md 'How a finding is tested'; the thresholds are proposals, merged by Seb's 20 Oct rule, and change only through a spec
